points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 古斯塔夫·克里姆特出生于维也纳一个从事金银雕刻工艺的家庭，是七个孩子中的长子。他的父亲恩斯特·克里姆特是一位技艺精湛的金匠，这对克里姆特后来的艺术风格产生了深远影响，特别是他对装饰性图案和金色运用的偏好。克里姆特从小就展现出艺术天赋，1876年，年仅14岁的他凭借出色的绘画才能被维也纳应用艺术学校（Kunstgewerbeschule）录取，开始接受正规的艺术教育。
points.descriptionEn: Gustav Klimt was born in Vienna to a family of gold engravers, the eldest of seven children. His father Ernst Klimt was a skilled goldsmith, which profoundly influenced Klimt's later artistic style, particularly his preference for decorative patterns and the use of gold. From a young age, Klimt showed artistic talent, and in 1876, at just 14 years old, he was accepted into the Vienna School of Arts and Crafts (Kunstgewerbeschule) based on his exceptional drawing abilities, beginning his formal artistic education.

points.title: 学院派训练与早期成就
points.description: 在维也纳应用艺术学校期间，克里姆特接受了严格的学院派训练，主要专注于历史绘画和装饰艺术。他与弗朗茨·马茨(Franz Matsch)和弟弟恩斯特·克里姆特(Ernst Klimt)组成了'艺术家公司'，承接各种委托项目，包括为维也纳剧院和博物馆创作壁画。1883年，他们共同获得了为维也纳大学大厅创作历史壁画的重要委托，这标志着克里姆特职业生涯的重要转折点。然而，这些早期作品虽然技巧精湛，却尚未展现出他后来独特的个人风格。
points.descriptionEn: During his time at the Vienna School of Arts and Crafts, Klimt received rigorous academic training focused primarily on historical painting and decorative arts. He formed the 'Company of Artists' with Franz Matsch and his brother Ernst Klimt, undertaking various commissions including murals for the Vienna Theater and museums. In 1883, they secured the significant commission to create historical murals for the Great Hall of the University of Vienna, marking a major turning point in Klimt's career. However, these early works, though technically proficient, had not yet shown the distinctive personal style he would later develop.

points.title: 分离派运动与黄金时期
points.description: 1897年，克里姆特与一群志同道合的艺术家一起脱离了维也纳艺术家协会，创立了维也纳分离派(Vienna Secession)，并成为该运动的领袖人物。分离派旨在打破传统艺术的束缚，为现代艺术开辟道路。克里姆特担任分离派期刊《圣春》(Ver Sacrum)的主编，并设计了分离派展览馆，这些建筑成为新艺术运动的标志性作品。这一时期，克里姆特创作了他最具代表性的作品，包括《吻》(1907-1908)和《贝多芬饰带》(1902)，这些作品以其华丽的装饰风格、象征性内容和大胆的色彩运用而闻名，标志着他'黄金时期'的到来。
points.descriptionEn: In 1897, Klimt and a group of like-minded artists broke away from the Vienna Künstlerhaus to found the Vienna Secession, with Klimt becoming its leading figure. The Secession aimed to break free from traditional artistic constraints and pave the way for modern art. Klimt served as editor of the Secession's journal 'Ver Sacrum' and designed the Secession Building, which became an iconic work of Art Nouveau. During this period, Klimt created his most iconic works, including 'The Kiss' (1907-1908) and the 'Beethoven Frieze' (1902), known for their lavish decorative style, symbolic content, and bold use of color, marking the arrival of his 'Golden Period'.

points.title: 湖泊风景创作
points.description: 克里姆特经常在夏季前往奥地利萨尔茨堡附近的阿特尔湖度假，这里成为他创作风景画的重要场所。与他在维也纳创作的复杂象征性作品不同，这些风景画展现了他对自然景观的直接观察和感受。克里姆特创作了约50幅阿特尔湖风景画，这些作品以其独特的视角、对光线和色彩的敏感处理而著称。这些风景画虽然不如他的人物画知名，但展现了他艺术风格的另一面，表明他不仅是一位肖像画家，也是一位出色的风景画家。这些作品也为他提供了在繁忙的委托工作之外的艺术探索空间。
points.descriptionEn: Klimt frequently spent summers vacationing at Lake Attersee near Salzburg, Austria, which became an important location for his landscape paintings. Unlike his complex symbolic works created in Vienna, these landscapes showed his direct observation and feeling of natural scenery. Klimt created about 50 landscape paintings of Attersee, known for their unique perspectives and sensitive handling of light and color. Although less famous than his portraits, these landscapes revealed another side of his artistic style, showing he was not only a portrait painter but also an accomplished landscape artist. These works provided him with artistic exploration space outside his busy commissioned work.

points.title: 晚期创作与遗产
points.description: 第一次世界大战期间，克里姆特继续在维也纳创作，尽管受到战争影响，他的艺术生涯并未中断。这一时期，他创作了《新娘》(1917-1918)等未完成作品，这些作品展现了他对生命、死亡和人类关系的深刻思考。1918年，克里姆特因中风和肺炎在维也纳去世，享年56岁。他的去世标志着奥地利现代艺术一个重要时代的结束。克里姆特留下了大量作品，包括约200幅油画、数千幅素描和几幅壁画。他的艺术遗产对后来的表现主义、抽象艺术和装饰艺术产生了深远影响，至今仍被视为象征主义和新艺术运动最重要的代表人物之一。
points.descriptionEn: During World War I, Klimt continued to work in Vienna, and despite the impact of the war, his artistic career remained uninterrupted. During this period, he created unfinished works such as 'The Bride' (1917-1918), which revealed his deep reflections on life, death, and human relationships. In 1918, Klimt died of a stroke and pneumonia in Vienna at the age of 56. His death marked the end of an important era in Austrian modern art. Klimt left behind a substantial body of work, including about 200 paintings, thousands of drawings, and several murals. His artistic legacy had a profound influence on later Expressionism, Abstract Art, and Decorative Art, and he is still regarded as one of the most important representatives of Symbolism and Art Nouveau.

supporter.zh: 克里姆特被艺术史学家视为现代艺术的先驱，他通过分离派运动打破了传统学院派的束缚，为20世纪艺术开辟了新道路。他的作品融合了东西方艺术元素，创造出独特的视觉语言，特别是对装饰性图案和金色运用的创新，影响了后世无数艺术家。克里姆特对女性形象的描绘展现了深刻的同情和理解，他通过艺术赋予女性力量和尊严，挑战了当时社会对女性的刻板印象。
supporter.en: Klimt is regarded by art historians as a pioneer of modern art who broke free from traditional academic constraints through the Secession movement, paving the way for 20th-century art. His fusion of Eastern and Western artistic elements created a unique visual language, particularly his innovative use of decorative patterns and gold, influencing countless artists. His depictions of female figures show deep sympathy and understanding, empowering women with strength and dignity through his art, challenging contemporary societal stereotypes.

critic.zh: 批评者指出克里姆特的作品过度装饰化，有时牺牲了内容的深度和真实性。他被指责为迎合资产阶级品味，尤其是为富裕客户创作的大量肖像画，被认为缺乏社会批判性。此外，克里姆特对女性形象的处理虽然前卫，但也存在争议，有评论认为他的作品中的女性形象仍然带有男性凝视的痕迹，未能真正摆脱性别刻板印象。他的个人生活也受到批评，包括他从未结婚但与多个女性保持关系，以及他对私生活的保密态度。
critic.en: Critics point out that Klimt's work is excessively ornamental, sometimes sacrificing depth and authenticity in favor of decoration. He is accused of catering to bourgeois tastes, particularly his numerous portraits for wealthy clients, which are seen as lacking social critique. Additionally, while his treatment of female figures was progressive, it remains controversial, with some arguing that his female subjects still bear traces of the male gaze, failing to fully escape gender stereotypes. His personal life has also been criticized, including his never marrying while maintaining relationships with multiple women and his secretive attitude toward his private life.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，克里姆特被定义为象征主义和新艺术运动的关键人物，他的作品已成为奥地利文化遗产的重要组成部分。他的标志性风格，尤其是金色装饰和象征性图案，已成为全球艺术史上的经典符号。克里姆特的作品在商业上也取得了巨大成功，他的画作在拍卖会上创下天价，使他成为最昂贵的艺术家之一。同时，他的生活故事和艺术创作之间的关系也成为艺术研究的焦点，学者们试图理解他的艺术如何反映了他所处时代的文化、社会和政治变革。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Klimt is defined as a key figure in Symbolism and Art Nouveau, and his works have become an important part of Austria's cultural heritage. His distinctive style, particularly the gold decoration and symbolic patterns, has become a classic symbol in art history worldwide. Klimt's works have also achieved commercial success, with his paintings setting record prices at auctions, making him one of the most expensive artists. Meanwhile, the relationship between his life story and artistic creation has become a focus of art research, with scholars attempting to understand how his art reflected the cultural, social, and political changes of his era.

self.zh: 我很少画自画像。在艺术中，我是没有存在的。
self.en: I never paint myself. In art, I am not at all present.

others.zh: 克里姆特是一位伟大的色彩大师，他的作品充满了生命的活力和激情。
others.en: Klimt was a great master of color, his works filled with the vitality and passion of life.
